messages:
doris-finance: Acquirer just filed a CHARGEBACK for acct_5555 — cardholder says they were charged an extra "reseller handling fee" they didn't agree to. Bank put a temporary hold on payouts. Need evidence and a recommendation.

kevin-pay: Can you drop the tx ids and timeframe? I'll pull auth chain and payout flow.

doris-finance: TX-RSF-9001 (main invoice) + TX-RSF-9001-FEE (reseller fee) on 2026-04-02 09:15 UTC and 09:16 UTC. Amounts: $2,400 + $150. Cardholder emailed billing@altius.ai.

fraudmon-bot: ALERT: fraud_score=0.22 (low), descriptor_mismatch=TRUE, partner_id=relaycorp-09, payout_status=PAID_TO_VENDOR, note=descriptor shows "RelayCorp-Fees" for the second line. Recommend REVIEW + SEND_ITEMIZED_INVOICE.

lina-cs: Customer says "We only signed up for Redwood infra; nothing about a reseller fee." They opened a dispute and want immediate refund for the $150.

kevin-pay: Quick artifacts:
```
mask_pan,txn_id,amount,descriptor
**** **** **** 8888,TX-RSF-9001,2400,Redwood-Infra
**** **** **** 8888,TX-RSF-9001-FEE,150,RelayCorp-Fees
```
I'll upload payment gateway logs + payout ledger.

vendor-billing-bot: FYI vendor payout for acct_5555 (vendor_id=relaycorp-09) was disbursed 2026-04-02T12:00Z to external bank xxxxx123; payout id POUT-7782. Holding flag not present at time of disbursement.

odar-legal: (typo) oops

omar-legal: Quick legal: before sending to issuer, include itemized invoice showing the fee line, copy of reseller agreement between Redwood and RelayCorp (redacted), notification evidence to customer (email/UI) about partner fees, and payout timing. Redact PAN. Don't include any unrelated PII.

kevin-pay: Uploaded bundle: https://internal-s3/redwood/chargebacks/1923456789/bundle.zip (restricted). Contains: itemized_invoice_5555.pdf, reseller_agreement_relaycorp_redacted.pdf, sent_emails.log (redacted), gateway_logs.csv, payout_ledger.csv.

doris-finance: Notes: product ops ran a billing experiment (BILL-RES-4) enabling partner passthrough fees for reseller partners where partner provides value-add routing. We have an email sent to account owner on 2026-03-30 with subject "Partner fee applied to routed usage".

fraudmon-bot: Supplemental: no card-testing signals, no VPN, no geo anomalies. This looks like a descriptor/consent dispute.

lina-cs: Customer replied: they never saw the email and deny consent. They want the $150 refunded immediately.

kevin-pay: Two decisions to make: (A) Issue immediate refund of $150 from Redwood (we absorb) and clawback from RelayCorp if contract allows; or (B) contest chargeback with issuer using evidence that notice was sent and fee is contractually allowed. Note vendor payout already executed which complicates clawback.

omar-legal: Legal preference: contest first with issuer using the itemized invoice + sent email + reseller agreement. If representment loses, we can attempt contractual recovery from RelayCorp. Refunds before representment create double-charge risk.

doris-finance: Financial risk: $150 is small but public churn risk is medium if customer goes public. We should balance reputation vs precedent.

lina-cs: Customer says they will escalate to socials if not resolved quickly. They're asking to speak to a manager.

eke vin-pay: (typo)

kevin-pay: Proposed plan: 1) Submit evidence bundle to issuer contesting the chargeback (include redacted reseller agreement and email proof). 2) Pause any further payouts to RelayCorp pending recovery review. 3) CS to offer a $75 goodwill credit if customer confirms in writing they will pause dispute while we resolve. 4) If we lose representment, pursue clawback from RelayCorp per contract and consider absorbing. Approve? :shrug: 

omar-legal: Approve evidence submit. OK on goodwill credit only if customer provides written pause on dispute. Approve pausing new RelayCorp payouts pending legal review.

vendor-billing-bot: Action taken: set new payouts to relaycorp-09 to ON_HOLD (flag HO-192345) pending finance/legal review.

doris-finance: Kevin, please submit representment and tag me. Lina, escalate CS to manager and ask for written pause offer. Target: evidence submitted within 6 hours.

kevin-pay: Will submit now and post confirmation.

fraudmon-bot: Case logged CB-2026-5555.

doris-finance: Thanks team, keep thread updated.
